## Purpose
The strip along the top of every page: page data loading and actions in flight, filled only as far as they have measurably got.

## Responsibilities
- `TopProgressBar` combines the page-load tracking (`usePageLoadTracking`) and the ops store. It shows the read that is holding the page up longest, and lets the bar reach the end before fading.

## Key elements
`TopProgressBar`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Mounted in the app shell.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **This is the one place page loading is counted;** every loader reads the result.

Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
